meaning: the greatest of all time; unbeatable
origin: Initials of 永远的神. Spread from esports streams around 2019 (fans praising pro gamer Uzi), mainstream by 2021.

equivalent.es: el mejor de la historia / un crack

meaning: amazing, incredible; sometimes sarcastic: 'just wonderful'

equivalent.es: pasar de todo / bajarse del carro

equivalent.es: competencia absurda / la carrera de la rata

meaning: short for 内卷: to over-compete (卷起来了 = everyone is grinding)

equivalent.es: tirar la toalla / pasar de todo

meaning: cramming as many sights as possible into minimal time and money

meaning: cute way of saying 真的假的: really?!
origin: Baby-talk spelling of 真的假的, viral in 2023.

meaning: 太酷啦: so cool!
origin: Viral catchphrase in 2023.

meaning: the drained, worn-out look of an office worker

meaning: the emotional support or good feelings someone provides

meaning: deliberately unhinged rants used to vent or complain humorously

meaning: 'way ahead of everyone', often used ironically

meaning: someone who puts love above everything, even reason

meaning: a mediocre man with unearned confidence

meaning: someone brave only online

meaning: 'my youth is back!': nostalgia for something from childhood

meaning: hooked, infatuated, carried away

meaning: to make someone want to buy something (拔草 = cure the urge / finally buy)

origin: Self-help buzzword, 2022.

meaning: dramatic (sound-alike of English 'drama')

origin: 2022 internet slang.

meaning: sarcastic, dismissive agreement: sure, whatever you say

meaning: 'that's rude!' (playful call-out)

meaning: irony marker (the doge emoji): 'just kidding, don't come at me'

origin: Douyin, 2023.

term: 听君一席话，如听一席话
variants: 听君一席话,如听一席话
听君一席话如听一席话

meaning: to make grand promises that will never be kept (typically a boss)
